title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.22791v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). translated_title: 基于框架-策略优化的自进化编码智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在编码任务中展现出可喜的潜力，其性能由策略模型和作为智能体与环境交互中介的框架共同决定。事实上，框架与策略是相互促进的，仅进化其中一个组件是次优的——为某个检查点调优的框架可能无法针对更新后策略的失败模式，而策略学习也受限于固定框架所产生的轨迹。鉴于此，我们提出 Self-HPO，一个面向编码智能体的递归自我改进框架，它交替进行框架和策略优化，并将不断进化的策略作为自身框架的提议者。具体而言，在每一轮中，当前策略首先分析自身的失败并提出新的候选框架（H步骤）；随后在选定框架下通过强化学习（RL）更新策略（P步骤），并针对训练过程中识别出的困难任务进行……
tldr: 提出 Self-HPO 框架，通过交替优化智能体框架与策略模型，让进化的策略自己提出框架改进方案，从而实现编码智能体的递归自我进化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer.
